sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "dataprofile"."flowsign" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, AVG("dataprofile"."qltyscore") AS m1 FROM "dataprofile" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "dataprofile"."flowsign"  GROUP BY "dataprofile"."flowsign", "dataflow"."chanproto"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of data quality score per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto
gap to the all average of average of data quality score (all level)
rank within the group by average of data quality score, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, SUM("riskmanagement"."breachcount") AS m1 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink"  GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink", "dataflow"."chanproto"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of data breaches per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto (additive)
share of the all total of total of data breaches (all level)
rank within the group by total of data breaches, keep the top 3
